Course landforms v2.0-courses

Courses built from geography instead of floating blocks: one continuous ground line, rock that sits in soft soil, no ceiling unless something holds it up. Each strip is a whole course at true scale (left to right, wrapped). Off in the game unless the URL has ?courses=2.

Eight prototype courses

Landform key

Soft ground (soil, sand, snow, scree) is rounded and never steeper than its angle of repose. Rock and ice keep hard edges. Overheads only where something holds them: a cave's mountain, tree boughs, an ice shelf, an arch whose deck is above the frame.

Plan: 12 biomes × 4 layouts

One landform layout per existing course slot, 48 in all. Eight are built (marked). Recipes read left to right.
